purpose: Local noncommercial research: test metadata predictiveness for existing human happy/not_happy votes. No product integration, deployment, audio, acoustic feature access, FMA model transfer or musical-usefulness claim.
license: MTG metadata CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, sole noncommercial research use, attribution retained; source data and data-derived artifacts kept separately from MIT source and serving.
cohort: All exact native track IDs in frozen split0-test metadata, maximum15000. Join raw human rows on exact track ID; artist ID,album ID,path,duration must agree. Duplicate IDs/paths or conflicting identity fail closed. No replacements/subsampling/consensus selection. Persist identity-only cohort+folds before exposing human vote statistics or fitting.
eligibility: Only mood_happy with exactly3 votes all in {happy,not_happy}; retain disagreement. Others excluded with denominators/reasons. No other human taxonomy may enter features or model selection.
components: Union native artist IDs and album IDs across whole cohort before labels; duplicate same path/track rejected. Exact duplicate identity handled; audio-fingerprint/alias cross-source duplicates cannot be established with metadata and are an explicit residual limitation. No cross-source join/FMA inputs.
folds: 5 folds: int(SHA256('opennoise-jamendo-human-happy-v1|'+minimum_track_id_decimal).hexdigest(),16)%5 per connected component; no balancing or reseeding.
fit: For each heldoutfold, only eligible training rows. Each row weight1/(eligible training rows in its component). Vocabulary sorted genre--- and instrument--- tags occurring but not universal across eligible training rows. No mood/theme/artist/album/track IDs,duration,humanotherlabels as features. pi=(1+sum w*y)/(2+sum w), y=happy_votes/3; theta_h,j=(1+sum w*y*xj)/(2+sum w*y), theta_n,j=(1+sum w*(1-y)*xj)/(2+sum w*(1-y)). Bernoulli posterior with presence AND absence loglikelihoods and fixed alpha1; no search/tuning. Empty vocabulary yields prior. No training eligible rows =>abstain all methods in that fold.
methods: uploader_happy_tag_privileged_diagnostic: if mood/theme---happy present p=1 else trainingprior; explicitly additional input not matched feature comparison
metrics: Primary NB-minus-prior component-equal mean individual-vote Brier: p*p-2*p*y+y, lowerbetter. Identical eligible querysets, report coverage/allnominated denominator, fold/component/artist/albumcounts, missingvotes/disagreement, componentmaxsize, unseen featuretags. Auxiliary trackweighted Brier and mean (p-y)^2. Fixed bootstrap2000 resamples eligiblecomponents PCG64 seed20261017; percentile2.5/97.5 conditional fixedOOF predictions, not retraining/population significance.
freeze: Protocol before source acquisition/model outcomes. A GitHub contents metadata attempt returned TSV text unexpectedly; only JSON parse error beginning with header was exposed; no rows retained or examined and no models run. Cohort/fold hash frozen after identity parsing before human labels exposed. Store predictions then evaluation; independent implementation/replay verifies.
